mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 57 degrees with clear skies by Reddan Soccer Park and an air quality index of 53. We are currently in the third quarter moon phase, and you can catch a glimpse of the International Space Station at 4:57 AM as it rises in the west northwest near Cross Plains, heading southeast toward the Oregon area near Costco, reaching about halfway up the sky.

City residents should note that refuse and recycling services are managed by Pellitteri Waste Systems. You can find your specific collection calendar, sign up for alerts, or use the Waste Wizard tool on the city website to determine proper disposal for various household items.

We have a full slate of activities starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Looking ahead, tomorrow features trivia nights at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza specials at Lake Lou-ee.
Regarding recent safety updates, on October 25, Verona police officers conducted a welfare check at a local intersection and subsequently arrested a 40-year-old man for his first offence of O W I.
The flavor of the day is the delightful Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM for your enjoyment.
